title: 012 贫X、畏高、会长大人！

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    在一条平平无奇的无人街道上，一个人突然没有丝毫先兆的出现在了那里，不是走来的，更不是飞来的，是真的‘出现’出来的，就好像是凭空长出来的一样！
身穿白色的短袖衬衫和黑色牛仔长裤，腰上系着一把无护手的武士刀，黑发黑瞳，来人手中抓着一把树枝，树枝上…窜着一块已经发凉的烤肉…
副本世界：旋风管家！
副本任务：清除！
任务一：进入白皇学院，成为白皇学院一名高中部的学生；
任务奖励：装备点、道具点、能力点、召唤点各1000；
任务二：未开启；
任务三：未开启；
茫然的张开自己的眼睛，无言首先听到的是系统发放的副本任务，然后才开向周围。
街道，十分普通的街道，却给了无言自从三个月前穿越之后就不曾再出现的安全感。
身在一个陌生的异世，无言就算神经再大条，也无法放松下来，将大部分时间都拿来升级做任务的无言，又怎么敢放松呢，一个不小心，就会死在森林里，成为魔兽的粪便。
而久违的熟悉街道，却是给了无言难以言明的安全感，一直紧绷着的身体，也逐渐的放松了下来，脸上浮现温馨的笑容。
当然，只要不看他手上拿着的烤肉…
“滴！使用者，当您完成所有的副本任务之后，才能够离开该副本世界，当任务一完成的时候，任务二便会开启，当任务二完成的时候，任务三才会开启，当使用者完成任务三的时候，使用者便能离开该副本世界！”
“提醒使用者，副本世界与现实世界的时间比例是100:1，所以使用者可以放心的进行副本历练，祝您副本愉快！”
100：1？
也就是说，自己在这里呆上一年，斯巴利尔世界也才过去3天半的意思吗？
修炼作弊器啊作弊器，不过我喜欢！
嘿嘿笑了笑，看了看手中的烤肉，无言脸上一囧，飞快的将其飞掉，拍了拍手，便走了出去。
现在首先要做的，就是好好的吃一顿饭，在斯巴利尔世界，自己吃的不是水果，就是烤肉，虽然补给小镇上不是没有好吃的，但是饭店里又怎么可能找得到中华料理呢？

系统道具选项里虽然也有，但是用珍贵的道具点换吃的，不是不可以，等以后发家致富的时候再说吧，虽然不贵，但是蚊子腿也是肉啊…
而在旋风管家的世界里，虽然剧情是发生在岛国上，但是怎么说，也应该有一两道同世界风味的菜吧…
嘛…虽然没有钱，但是无言有金币啊，斯巴利尔世界用来做货币的金币，放到这个世界上，可是会被当成黄金来看的，一个金币都足够吃上十顿了。
此时，无言正站在一件十分宽大、华丽的建筑面前，手中拿着一张地图，看着门口，一脸的窘迫。
在狠狠的吃了一顿日式料理之后，无言就从收了一个金币一脸笑容的店家那里要来了这么一张地图，他可不想再吃不知道路的苦头了。
也多亏了系统自带的全语言精通功能，要不然，无言连点菜都没得点。
而眼前的这栋华丽的建筑，就是白皇学院了！
虽然这个世界带给了无言一点安全感，但是无言也没有忘记自己的任务，任务一就是加入白皇学院，成为一名学生。
无言不知道为什么系统会发放这样的副本任务，但是有点数赚的事情，无言是不会客气的！
至于为什么一脸的窘迫呢？原因是因为无言眼前这位正站在白皇学院门口，一脸警戒的看着自己的大姐。
浅绿色的齐肩短发，额头长着一颗不知道是痣还是疮的小突点，一看就是一位不得安宁的主，这位主，现在正一脸戒备的摆着打算干架的姿势，恶狠狠的看着无言。
桂雪路，桂雏菊的神经姐姐，这就是无言对她的所有认知。
原著里，主角绫崎飒来给他的大小姐三千院凪送便当的时候，也是遭到了桂雪路的阻止，原因是，不守好门，她会被扣工资…
因为如此坑爹的理由，这位神经大姐就将所有白皇学院以外的人拒之门外，一见外人就开打，这何其坑…
据系统说的是，无言进入有剧情的副本的时间，都会是剧情开始的前一天，也就是说，现在，主角绫崎飒还在送快递，而没想到的是，这位大姐，居然就已经开始在守门了。
虽然不知道绫崎飒会是什么时候来到白皇学院的，但是无言只知道，自己可能会有点麻烦了。
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢少女大召唤请大家
content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. On an ordinary deserted street, a person suddenly appeared there without any warning. He did not come, let alone fly. He really 'appeared', as if he had grown out of thin air!
Wearing a white short-sleeved shirt and black denim trousers, with an unguarded samurai sword tied around his waist, he has black hair and black eyes. The person holding a branch is holding a branch, and on the branch... there is a piece of cold barbecue...
Dungeon World: Tornado Butler!
Copy mission: Clear!
Task 1: Enter White King College and become a high school student of White King College;
Mission rewards: 1,000 equipment points, prop points, ability points, and summoning points each;
Task 2: Not started;
Task 3: Not started;
Opening his eyes blankly, Wu Yan first heard the copy mission issued by the system, and then he drove around.
The street, a very ordinary street, gave Wu Yan a sense of security that he had never experienced since he traveled through it three months ago.
In a strange world, Wu Yan couldn't relax no matter how nervous he was. How could Wu Yan, who spent most of his time upgrading and completing tasks, dare to relax? If he wasn't careful, he would die in the forest and become the excrement of a monster.
But being familiar with the streets for a long time gave him an indescribable sense of security. His body, which had been tense, gradually relaxed, and a warm smile appeared on his face.
Of course, as long as you don't look at the barbecue he's holding...
"Hey! User, only after you complete all the dungeon tasks can you leave the dungeon world. When task 1 is completed, task 2 will be opened. When task 2 is completed, task 3 will be opened. When the user completes task 3, the user can leave the dungeon world!"
"Remind users that the time ratio between the dungeon world and the real world is 100:1, so users can safely practice the dungeon. I wish you a happy dungeon!"
100:1?
In other words, after staying here for a year, does it mean that only three and a half days have passed in Sparir World?
It’s a training cheat, oh a cheat, but I like it!
Hehe smiled, looked at the barbecue in his hand, Wuyan looked embarrassed, quickly flew it away, clapped his hands, and walked out.
The first thing to do now is to have a good meal. In the Sparir world, what you eat is either fruit or barbecue. Although there is no delicious food in the supply town, how can you find Chinese food in the restaurant?
Although there are also system props in the options, it is not impossible to use precious props in exchange for food. Let’s wait until you get rich later. Although it is not expensive, mosquito legs are also meat...
In the world of Hayate the Combat Butler, although the plot takes place on an island country, there should be one or two dishes with flavors from around the world...
Well... Although there is no money, there are gold coins in Wuyan. The gold coins used as currency in the Sparir world will be regarded as gold in this world. One gold coin is enough to eat ten meals.
At this time, Wu Yan was standing in front of a very large and gorgeous building, holding a map in his hand and looking at the door with a look of embarrassment on his face.
After a hearty meal of Japanese food, Wuyan asked for a map like this from the store owner who took a gold coin and smiled on his face. He didn't want to suffer the pain of not knowing the road again.
Thanks to the system's built-in full language proficiency function, otherwise, Wuyan wouldn't even be able to order.
And this gorgeous building in front of you is the White Emperor Academy!
Although this world has given Wuyan a sense of security, Wuyan has not forgotten his mission. The first mission is to join the White Emperor Academy and become a student.
Wu Yan doesn’t know why the systemI would not be polite to issue such a dungeon mission, but if I want to earn points!
As for why he looked embarrassed? The reason was because the eldest sister in front of Wu Yan was standing at the gate of White Emperor Academy, looking at him warily.
He has light green shoulder-length hair and a small bump on his forehead that is either a mole or a sore. He looks like a restless master. This master is now looking at Wu Yan with a wary look on his face, as if he is planning to fight.
Gui Xuelu, Gui Daiju’s neurotic sister, this is all Wu Yan knows about her.
In the original work, when the protagonist Ayazaki Sa came to deliver a lunch to his eldest lady Sanzenin Nagi, she was also stopped by Katsura Yuetiro. The reason was that if she did not guard the door, her salary would be deducted...
For such a deceptive reason, this crazy eldest sister shuts out everyone outside the White Emperor Academy and starts fighting whenever she sees outsiders. How deceptive is this...
According to the system, the time Wu Yan enters a dungeon with a plot will be the day before the plot begins. In other words, now, the protagonist Ayazaki Sa is still delivering express delivery, but to his surprise, this eldest sister has already started guarding the door.
Although he didn't know when Ayazaki Sa would come to White Emperor Academy, Wu Yan only knew that he might be in some trouble.
